fields.title: About Our School
fields.content:
Novel International School is committed to imparting quality education with a strong emphasis on developing essential life skills that prepare children for a successful and meaningful future. The school focuses on nurturing well-rounded individuals who are confident, responsible, and capable of meeting the challenges of the twenty-first century.

Understanding the evolving objectives of modern education, Novel International School offers a wide range of academic and co-curricular activities designed to provide value-oriented learning. The institution strives to shape students into global citizens by fostering critical thinking, creativity, discipline, and ethical values in a supportive and inspiring environment.

The school is managed by the Pandikasala Mundottil Yousuf Charitable Trust, which is dedicated to achieving the educational vision laid down by its visionary leaders and ensuring excellence in all aspects of schooling.

fields.history_content:
Novel International School was established in 2006 in Jeddah with the vision of providing high-quality education focused on academic excellence and life-skill development. Over time, the residents of Pulikkal recognized the growing need for a premier educational institution that could cater to the aspirations of children in a rapidly changing global landscape.

In response to this need, Novel International School expanded its mission to serve students by aligning education with global standards while preserving strong moral and cultural values. Since its inception, the school has continuously evolved to meet modern educational demands and remains committed to shaping future-ready students through holistic and value-based education.
